description: This file defines an Admin React component used for managing blog posts, including features to add, edit, delete, and list posts via API calls. It also renders UI elements for post management and API endpoint information.

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Fetches the list of posts from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new post and refreshes the post list.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing post and refreshes the post list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a post after user confirmation and refreshes the post list.
